resources.name: Nonuniform condensing heat-flux profile on TE module surface

access.notes: CSV containing the condensing ratio distribution along the module top surface (width 2.5 mm), derived from the optical simulation of the water lens.

Polynomial functions of temperature for thermal conductivity, Seebeck coefficient, and electrical conductivity of p-type and n-type elements, electrodes, and insulator as given in the paper's Table 1. Will be provided directly in the task instruction.
